task: Verify the code-review fixes: (1) inventory.py mark_sold rejects a replayed sell with 409 'Item is already marked sold' and preserves sold_price/sold_at; (2) TillSellDialog surfaces the backend detail string and invalidates ['inventory'] on 409; (3) shops.py writes shop_merged/shop_deleted/shop_disabled activity_log entries; (4) db.py ensure_indexes covers pricing_ledger(item_id,created_at desc), pricing_rules(version desc), shops(id unique).
action_items: Pre-existing backend failures (out of scope, unchanged from prior iterations): test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating / test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint fail because the /tmp/item.jpg fixture image is missing from this environment; test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data expects Chiswick High Road needs_zone_review=True but got False (seed-flag residue from prior iterations).

checks.criterion: Replayed sell is rejected (idempotency guard) + sold item can still return to floor
checks.name: test_tscheck_sell_idempotency.py
checks.evidence: New file, 2 tests. PATCH /inventory/{id}/sell {sold:true, sold_price:5.00} -> 200 status=sold sold_price=5.00. Replay PATCH {sold:true, sold_price:99.99} -> 409 detail=='Item is already marked sold'. GET afterwards: sold_price still 5.00, sold_at unchanged from the canonical stored value. Second test: sold->available (200, sold_price/sold_at null) then available->sold again succeeds 200 (guard is one-way). 2 passed.

checks.criterion: Till Mode UI surfaces the 409 reason on a cross-device race
checks.name: till-race-409-shows-backend-detail
checks.evidence: New check. Master opens till dialog for a fresh tscheck-till-race-* item while available (till-confirm-sell visible), then a parallel API call marks it sold (simulating the second device). Clicking 'Mark sold' on the stale dialog fires the mutation, gets 409, and the toast shows the literal text 'Item is already marked sold' (asserted present; 'request failed with 409' and 'could not mark sold' asserted absent). Reopening the till dialog for the same SKU afterwards shows the 'till-already-sold' branch, confirming the ['inventory'] query was invalidated on 409. Ran locally and re-ran once more through the public preview URL (https://thrift-vision.preview.emergentagent.com) — both passed. One benign console 409 network log (expected, the race itself).

checks.criterion: Shop merge writes an activity log entry (shop_merged, target name + items_reassigned)
checks.name: test_tscheck_shop_activity_log.py::test_shop_merge_writes_shop_merged_activity_entry
checks.evidence: Created tscheck dup/target shops + 1 linked item, DELETE /shops/{dup}?mode=remove&reassign_to={target} -> 200. GET /api/activity (master) found an action=='shop_merged' entry with details.target_shop_name==target_name, details.items_reassigned>=1, username=='master'.

checks.criterion: Shop hard-delete (empty shop) writes an activity log entry (shop_deleted)

checks.evidence: Created an empty tscheck shop, DELETE /shops/{id}?mode=remove -> 200. GET /api/activity found action=='shop_deleted' with details.shop_name matching, username=='master'.

checks.criterion: Shop disable (soft) writes an activity log entry (shop_disabled)
checks.name: test_tscheck_shop_activity_log.py::test_shop_soft_disable_writes_shop_disabled_activity_entry
checks.evidence: Created a tscheck shop, DELETE /shops/{id} (default mode) -> 200 and disabled:true in response. GET /api/activity found action=='shop_disabled' with details.shop_name matching, username=='master'.

checks.criterion: Pricing ledger / pricing rules / shops indexes applied by ensure_indexes()
